successRate.definition: successful operator events / all operator events

evidenceCompleteness.definition: executed events with evidence / executed events

latencyP95Ms.definition: 95th percentile measured operator latency in milliseconds

fallbackRate.definition: events using delegated fallback / all operator events

executedRate.definition: events with real executor attempt / all operator events

directProviderReadiness.definition: Orange provider adapters live-ready / configured provider adapters

secretExposure.definition: telemetry records containing intent, payload, provider output or credential values

unverifiedCompletion.definition: executed actions declared complete without evidence

data_quality.conflictPolicy: live evidence wins over registry or memory
data_quality.redactionPolicy: no intent, payload, credentials or provider response body
